_README: MALAY (ms) SALVAGE — the only real translations from the parked Malay dictionary.
WHERE THIS CAME FROM: index.html, the >>> AUTO-MERGED FULL UI TRANSLATIONS <<< block,
language key "ms", extracted at commit f726d05 on 2026-08-05 before that block was deleted.
WHY THE REST WAS DROPPED: the ms dictionary held 1636 keys, of which 1567 (95.8%) were
BYTE-IDENTICAL to their English key — i.e. English text wearing a Malay label. Malay was
never selectable (absent from #langSel, #lkLangSel and langLocale()), so no user could ever
see it, yet it cost 140,833 bytes = 6.9% of every mobile download and kept tools/i18n/sync.js
permanently red at MISSING: 61. Council ruling team/council/2026-08-05-theming-and-singapore.md
WHAT IS IN HERE: the 69 keys (4.2%) whose Malay value differed from the English key — the only
genuine translation work in that dictionary. Kept verbatim so that if Malay is ever wanted it
starts from real words instead of nothing.
HEALTH WARNING BEFORE REUSE: an earlier automated Malay pass corrupted words by blind substring
replacement (inside -> dalamside, Update -> Upddie, month -> blnnth) and sync.js reported
MISSING: 0 and the release gate reported GREEN throughout — see team/logs/mikoto.md 2026-07-08.
Every value below must be read by a Malay speaker before it is trusted. A few keys here are
already orphaned in the app (e.g. the old Discord renewal line); check against the live source
This file is reference data only. Nothing loads it and nothing tests it.
